# A strong claim resting on one line of enquiry

## Executive Summary

Five sources agree [1][2][3][4][5].

## Introduction

Scope.

## Findings

### Finding 1: Five sources agree, but all came from one search

**Confidence: Strong** - five separate publishers reported it.

Every one of these was surfaced by the same query, so they are five reports of
one thing rather than five confirmations [1][2][3][4][5].

## Synthesis

Nothing independent here.

## Limitations

Single line of enquiry.

## Recommendations

Search differently.
